description: Expand a spec or request fingerprint (ptpge-cfs/1, full 64-hex or 16-hex short form) back into its structured configuration — the read-back path for MIS/ERP: matched profile, product, every binding with resolved labels, the canonical string, and the dataset version. This is a LOOKUP in the public resolver (ptpge.org/f/), not an inversion of the hash: it resolves when the fingerprint has been registered (every fingerprint computed by ptpge_fingerprint is self-registered within seconds). An unregistered fingerprint is still a valid identity — it simply has no stored expansion yet; returns status 'unknown' then.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex (64) or the 16-hex short form, with or without the resolver URL prefix.

name: ptpge_expand_fingerprint
title: Expand a fingerprint
